# Rollback Drill Decision: Atlas Rehearsals

**Date:** 2026-07-02
**Participants:** Quinton Fairweather (CTO)

Quinton: "Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have."

Key decisions:
- **Cadence**: monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals
- **Owner**: Quinton Fairweather

mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive issued as a standing order — the speaker enacts authority by unilaterally setting a recurring cadence the organization must follow.

The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that either holds a capability or does not — while the conditional framing ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have') asserts authority over what counts as real capability, collapsing rehearsal into possession.

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring schedule, appealing to stability/readiness (conservation) and the capability to execute (competence).
Asserts that an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback at all, framing rehearsal as the condition for genuine capability (competence) and security (conservation).

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the text arguing that a preparedness claim is hollow unless it has been practiced?

observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, matter-of-fact register — scheduling a recurring practice with no urgency or alarm, conveying confident satisfaction.
Aphoristic framing carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is declared as effectively nonexistent, pressing the stakes with high-arousal negative valence.

mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker raising urgency by declaring that an unpracticed capability is effectively nonexistent?

positions.name: RehearsalConstitutesCapability
positions.frame: does a capability count as genuinely held only once it has been rehearsed, and what cadence secures that?
positions.why: The directive fixes a monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollbacks (src-1), and the aphoristic assertion supplies the warrant for why cadence matters at all — an unrehearsed rollback is treated as no rollback (src-2). Read together, both expressions perform the same underlying stance (value: competence/conservation; conviction: decision and principle both load-bearing, unhedged) that rehearsal is constitutive of, not incidental to, having the capability. The tension between the two acts — a flat operational order versus a crystallized maxim — is held within the frame rather than resolved: one performs the policy, the other performs its justification.
